notes.citation: Home Office (2026) Crime outcomes in England and Wales 2025 to 2026, Table 3.1, number of outcomes assigned by offence type and outcome group, year ending March 2026. London: Home Office. The charged or summonsed column, total victim offences 319,984 plus total state offences 127,530. The table states that it counts crimes recorded in the year, which is the recorded basis, that it covers all 44 forces including British Transport Police, and that it excludes fraud and Computer Misuse Act offences.

notes.citation: Home Office (2026) Crime outcomes in England and Wales 2025 to 2026, Table 3.1, as above. The out-of-court formal and informal column, total victim offences 111,286 plus total state offences 105,923. That column covers outcome types 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8. Outcome 22 is grouped separately by the Home Office and so is excluded from this target, which is why the target names its outcome types rather than using the dashboard's own out of court total.
